item.title: With Israel’s airspace shut, Arkia starts flying homeward-bound Israelis to Egyptian border
item.description: Amid uncertainty regarding when flights will resume, land border crossing and maritime travel routes can help stranded Israelis and travelers get in and out, at a high cost The post With Israel’s airspace shut, Arkia starts flying homeward-bound Israelis to Egyptian border appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Three tankers damaged in Gulf and one seafarer killed as US-Iran conflict escalates
item.description: Unclear who fired projectiles and drones that hit ships; over 200 vessels drop anchor around Strait of Hormuz, closed by Iran; major container shipping lines reroute round Africa The post Three tankers damaged in Gulf and one seafarer killed as US-Iran conflict escalates appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Four of the 9 victims of Iranian missile strike on Beit Shemesh named by authorities
item.description: Ronit Elimelech, an emergency service volunteer, was killed alongside her mother, Sara; Oren Katz, 16-year-old Gavriel Baruch Ravach also confirmed to be among the victims The post Four of the 9 victims of Iranian missile strike on Beit Shemesh named by authorities appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Trump says he’s agreed to talk to Iran’s leaders, but estimates operation will take weeks
item.description: White House official says dialogue with 'new potential leadership' to take place 'eventually'; president continues to urge public to overthrow regime in wake of Khamenei's death The post Trump says he’s agreed to talk to Iran’s leaders, but estimates operation will take weeks appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: After overnight lull, Iran launches new missile, drone strikes on Israel, Gulf states
item.description: Iranian drone attack causes damage at UK military base in Cyprus overnight * Israeli Air Force launches new wave of strikes on Iranian regime targets in Tehran, Hezbollah in Lebanon The post After overnight lull, Iran launches new missile, drone strikes on Israel, Gulf states appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Three wounded in Iranian missile strike on highway outside Jerusalem
item.description: Man, 46, in moderate condition after stopping vehicle on edge of crater caused by blast, as Iran continues to launch missiles across the region in response to US-Israeli bombing The post Three wounded in Iranian missile strike on highway outside Jerusalem appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Israeli who survived 9/11 and October 7 now faces down Iranian missiles in Dubai
item.description: Chicago native Deborah Benson-Ben Aderet is stranded in the United Arab Emirates while her two daughters weather the war in their southern Israel home The post Israeli who survived 9/11 and October 7 now faces down Iranian missiles in Dubai appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: IDF strikes in Beirut after Hezbollah enters fray and fires rockets, drones at north
item.description: No reports of injuries or damage; terror group says attacks are 'revenge' for Khamenei's killing, as Lebanese PM condemns 'irresponsible act'; IDF vows forceful response The post IDF strikes in Beirut after Hezbollah enters fray and fires rockets, drones at north appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Dubai’s carefully built image as sun-filled safe haven shattered by Iranian strikes
item.description: The UAE is experiencing its 'ultimate nightmare,' expert says, as damage caused by hundreds of Iranian projectiles puts a dent in the Gulf state's reputation with tourists The post Dubai’s carefully built image as sun-filled safe haven shattered by Iranian strikes appeared first on The Times of Israel.

item.title: Drone hit British military base in Cyprus, local and UK officials say
item.description: RAF Akrotiri sustained minor damage, area residents received alert to shelter, Cyprus says; Britain reportedly drawing up plan to evacuate all nationals from Middle East The post Drone hit British military base in Cyprus, local and UK officials say appeared first on The Times of Israel.
